message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  

If you need the most up‑to‑date figure, you can check one of the following reliable sources:

| Source | How to find it |
|--------|----------------|
| **Bloomberg** | Search “Gold Spot Price” on Bloomberg.com or use the Bloomberg Terminal ticker `XAUUSD`. |
| **Reuters** | Look up “Gold” on Reuters.com or use the ticker `XAUUSD`. |
| **Kitco** | Visit kitco.com/price-charts/spot-gold-price.html for the current spot price. |
| **Investing.com** | Search “Gold” on investing.com; the ticker is `XAUUSD`. |
| **Yahoo Finance** | Search “Gold” or `XAUUSD` on finance.yahoo.com. |

These sites update the spot price in real time (usually within seconds of the market). If you’re looking for a historical trend or a specific day’s closing price, most of them also provide charts and daily summaries.
